canonical_zone: ENV_R08 (The Deep Dwarven Forge of Master Grimsby)
full_title: Fiery-Bearded Master of the Deep Dwarven Forge

demographics.proportions: ~142 cm tall (4.4 heads tall — stout subterranean dwarf craftsman proportions, distinct from Ch. 3 silver-bearded horned Iron Outpost Blacksmith)
demographics.build: Ultra-broad barrel-chested, stout weathered subterraneansmith with heavy forearms

facial_features.face_shape: Broad square weathered dwarven face with light soot patina

hair.color: Thick auburn-copper hair (#A83D24) — NO horned helmet; wears brass forge goggles pushed up across forehead
hair.style: Bushy swept-back locks secured beneath a wide leather goggle strap

beard_and_mustache.style: Massive booming wide braided fiery beard secured with small brass ring clasps beneath a thick sweeping copper mustache

facial_features.eyes: Warm intense amber-brown eyes (#7A421D) under thick fiery eyebrows

deep_dwarven_forge_apron.name: Deep Dwarven Forge Apron (Canonical Default)
deep_dwarven_forge_apron.description: No horned helmet; brass forge goggles pushed onto forehead, fiery copper braided beard, charcoal quilted forge jerkin (#3A3D42) with rolled sleeves and leather wrist wraps, oil-tanned russet leather apron (#7E4528) with brass rivets and caliper pockets, steel-toed forge boots (#6E747C), holding an octagonal bronze-steel Dwarven Rune-Hammer etched with + - * / math symbols.

master_vault_smith.name: Armor Vault Ceremonial Coat
master_vault_smith.description: Brushed clean of soot in deep slate dwarfsmith coat with bronze trim and steel shoulder clasps while unlocking the Dwarven Steel Armor vault.

art_style_dna.primary_style: Hand-drawn fantasy storybook illustration, Studio Ghibli meets Akira Toriyama Dragon Quest art style
art_style_dna.line_art: Clean warm-sepia and dark charcoal ink linework (#3E2B23)
art_style_dna.shading_technique: Warm watercolor & gouache with subterranean lava-amber lighting (#E07A38) and gleaming steel specular highlights (#D9E4EC)
art_style_dna.color_palette: Fiery copper beard (#C94A29), lava amber (#E07A38), russet leather (#7E4528), charcoal jerkin (#3A3D42), gleaming steel (#D9E4EC), operator gold (#D4A23C)
